records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Isla,

We know getting started can slip. If you want a hand setting up your first project or inviting your team, just reply -- happy to help.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Vantage Works set up
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Vantage Works* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no first project, no invites, zero tickets, and no reply to three outbound emails (email:e11d6563, email:6386e66a, email:9819da74). Total silence plus zero product progress on a Starter plan suggests low unaided odds of reaching the milestone in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting your first project going in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

I don't want to crowd your inbox, so this is my last nudge for now. If a first project is the piece that hasn't happened yet, that's a quick one to sort out -- projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. There's also an in-app onboarding flow that walks through creating a first project whenever you're ready.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through it with you and answer anything about getting your team in.

Best,
Chidi
